design_rationale: The study is described as a prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial using computerized randomization (2:1) with minimization.

domain_judgments.rationale: A computerized minimization algorithm was used to generate allocations and baseline characteristics were reasonably balanced given the small sample size.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Computerized randomization was performed 2:1 (TA:- placebo) with minimization on age, sex, baseline severity (National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale [NIHSS]), and time from stroke onset.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind and placebo-controlled with identical administration regimes, and analysis was conducted according to intention-to-treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We performed a prospective, randomized, placebocontrolled, blinded end point single-center phase IIa trial of TA in patients with acute spontaneous ICH. ... Analysis was by intention-to-treat; significance was taken at P less than .05.

domain_judgments.rationale: All 24 enrolled patients were followed up and included in the primary feasibility and main secondary clinical and safety analyses, with missing data limited to cognitive/mood questionnaires due to patient impairment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: No patients were lost to follow-up; however, cognition, mood, and quality of life data were missing in a number of participants who were unable to answer question because of communication problems.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blind and radiological and clinical endpoints were assessed blindly using standardized measures.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All image analyses were performed blinded to clinical status and treatment allocation.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was registered prospectively (ISRCTN50867461) and reported prespecified primary feasibility and secondary clinical, safety, and radiological outcomes consistently.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: ...was registered with a trial number (ISRCTN 50867461), and performed according to the Declaration of Helsinki and Good Clinical Practice.

overall_summary: All five RoB 2 domains were evaluated as low risk of bias due to robust computerized randomization/minimization, adequate double-blinding, complete participant follow-up, blinded outcome assessment, and protocol-congruent outcome reporting.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to the treatment or control group using envelopes assigned by a random sequence programmer.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although a random sequence generator was used, drawing envelopes from a box containing 30 closed envelopes is vulnerable to manipulation and does not ensure full allocation concealment, and there was a substantial baseline difference in initial hematoma volume between groups (10.6 cm3 vs 14.3 cm3).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients or their family members randomly chose one envelope from a box containing 30 closed envelopes. Each envelope represented either the drug or control group, which was assigned using a random sequence programmer.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was single-blinded (carers/providers were not blinded), placebo administration details were sparse, and post-randomization exclusions occurred that were not analyzed according to intention-to-treat principles.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients in the drug group were blinded and received a rapid administration of TXA... Two patients in the control group were withdrawn because of uncontrolled hypertension (systolic pressure > 200 mmHg for > 8 hours), and 3 patients in the treatment group were withdrawn because of data loss.

domain_judgments.rationale: Five participants (14% of the randomized cohort) were excluded or lost after randomization, and reasons for withdrawal (e.g., uncontrolled hypertension) are potentially related to the primary outcome of hematoma expansion.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Two patients in the control group were withdrawn because of uncontrolled hypertension (systolic pressure > 200 mmHg for > 8 hours), and 3 patients in the treatment group were withdrawn because of data loss.

domain_judgments.rationale: Haematoma volume was objectively quantified using CT planimetric software by a radiologist who was blinded to group allocation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: After 24 hours, another CT brain scan was performed, and a blinded radiologist evaluated the size and volume of the haematoma.

domain_judgments.rationale: No pre-registered protocol or statistical analysis plan was provided, and several secondary outcomes mentioned in the aims (such as surgical intervention and blood pressure influence) were reported incompletely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Statistical analysis using the Mann-Whitney U test... Control group showed significant hematoma expansion compared to treatment group (14.3300 vs 17.9940, P = 0.001).

overall_summary: The trial is at high risk of bias overall, primarily driven by missing outcome data with post-randomization exclusions related to clinical worsening/hypertension, compounded by concerns regarding allocation concealment and absence of a pre-specified analysis plan.

design_rationale: The study is an international, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled phase 3 superiority trial where participants were assigned 1:1 via central web-based minimisation.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was generated centrally via a secure web-based system with concealment maintained using identically packaged and sleeved ampoules, and baseline characteristics were well balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Randomisation was done centrally in real time. A secure website was used to randomly assign all participants eligible for inclusion to receive tranexamic acid or matching placebo, with 1:1 allocation... Randomisation was stratified by country, with minimisation for key prognostic factors... Treatment allocation was concealed from all staf and patients involved in the trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants, clinicians, and study staff were blinded using matching placebos, adherence was very high (95% full per-protocol treatment), and analysis adhered to the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Sharp Clinical Services (Crickhowell, UK) prepared individual masked treatment packs containing four 5 mL glass ampoules of tranexamic acid 500 mg or sodium chloride 0·9%, which were made identical in appearance by the addition of a heat shrink sleeve... All analyses were done on an intention-to-treat basis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Data on the primary outcome were available for over 99% of randomised participants, with negligible attrition balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary outcome was assessed for 2307 (99%) participants... nine (<1%) were lost to follow-up and nine (<1%) withdrew from their day 90 follow-up.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome (modified Rankin Scale at day 90) was evaluated by central certified outcome assessors who were blinded to treatment allocation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Central assessors, who were trained and certified in administration of the mRS and masked to treatment allocation, did the final follow-up at 90 days by telephone from the coordinating centre in each country.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered (ISRCTN93732214) with a pre-published statistical analysis plan, and reported outcomes align with the pre-specified analyses.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We followed a prespecified statistical plan and analysed the primary outcome as a shift in the mRS at 90 days, using ordinal logistic regression with adjustment for the stratification and minimisation criteria.

overall_summary: The study was a rigorously conducted, double-blind randomised placebo-controlled trial with central web-based allocation concealment, masked outcome assessors, >99% primary outcome completion, and analysis adhering to a prespecified intention-to-treat statistical plan. All five RoB 2 domains were assessed as low risk of bias.

design_rationale: The study is a prospective, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial with participants randomly allocated (1:1) using a centralised web-based system.

domain_judgments.rationale: Randomization used a centralized web-based procedure with permuted blocks of varying size, ensuring allocation concealment, and baseline characteristics were well balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Randomisation was done using a centralised web-based procedure with randomly permuted blocks of varying size.

domain_judgments.rationale: Patients, clinicians, and study staff were fully masked with identical packaging and preparation by an unmasked external person, and analysis was intention-to-treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients and all those involved in patient management or clinical or imaging assessment of adverse events or outcomes were masked to treatment allocation. The primary and safety analyses were done in the intention-to-treat population.

domain_judgments.rationale: Primary outcome data were available for 99 of 100 participants with prespecified worst-case imputation for the single missing patient, and full follow-up was completed for all participants at 3 months.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All patients had complete 3-month follow-up and study masking was not broken in any individual. One participant in the tranexamic acid group did not have a follow-up scan because of early palliation and was assigned the intracerebral haemorrhage growth outcome as per the statistical analysis plan.

domain_judgments.rationale: Haematoma volume was objectively quantified using standard planimetric software by investigators who were masked to treatment assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All patients, investigators, and staff involved in patient management were masked to treatment... Both baseline and 24 h intracerebral haemorrhage volumes were obtained in Osirix using planimetric techniques as described previously.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered, had a published protocol and prespecified statistical analysis plan, and reported all predefined primary and secondary outcomes accordingly.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The statistical analysis followed an analysis plan fixed before database lock. The trial is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT01702636).

overall_summary: The study is a rigorously conducted double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial with robust allocation concealment, high protocol fidelity, complete follow-up, blinded outcome assessment, and prespecified analyses, yielding a low risk of bias across all RoB 2 domains.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated (1:1) to tranexamic acid or matching placebo using a centralized, web-based procedure with minimization (80% probability to avoid predictable alternation) generated by an independent clinical trials unit.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation was performed via a centralized web-based minimization system with random element to conceal allocation, and baseline characteristics were balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants were randomly allocated to receive either TXA or matching placebo in a 1:1 ratio via a centralized, Web-based, secure procedure, with minimization for key prognostic factors (age, sex, National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale [NIHSS] score, and use of one of NOAC-specific reversal agents idarucizumab or andexanet alfa). To avoid predictable alternation of treatment allocation, and thus potential loss of allocation concealment, participants were allocated with a probability of 80% to the treatment group that would minimize betweengroup imbalances of the minimization factors. The randomization sequence was generated by the Clinical Trial Unit Basel.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants, caregivers, and trial personnel were blinded with matching placebo preparation by an unmasked nurse not involved in assessments, and an intention-to-treat analysis was performed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants, investigators involved in study assessments, and independent physicians involved in patient management were all masked to treatment allocation... After randomization, the assigned sealed treatment pack was handed to an unmasked nurse not involved in study assessments, who unsealed it, added the ampoules into bags of normal saline, and administered the appropriately labeled masked infusion bags to the participant.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were complete for 90-day follow-up and follow-up imaging was available for nearly all participants, with the two early deaths (1 per group) imputed as treatment failure per prespecified plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All participants had follow-up imaging, but 2 who died before follow-up imaging could be acquired (1 TXA and 1 placebo) and were assigned the HE outcome as prespecified in the statistical plan. All participants had complete 90-day follow-up, and allocation masking was not broken in any participant.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome was assessed using objective volumetric measurements on brain CT scans evaluated by blinded independent central raters.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All imaging assessments of deidentified scans were performed by an independent central reader (G.M.K.), masked to treatment allocation and clinical outcomes of the participants, and entered into the electronic case report... Independent validation of the volumetric assessments was performed by a second masked rater (B.M.S.) using different software... In case of disagreement about the presence versus absence of HE (ie, the primary outcome), a third tie-breaking rater (D.J.S.) was involved.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered with a pre-specified statistical analysis plan finalised before unmasking, and outcomes and analyses conformed to the protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: TICH-NOAC was performed and reported in accordance with the study protocol and prespecified statistical analysis plan (under version control; latest version 1.4 [dated April 16, 2020] made available online at https://clinicaltrials.gov (NCT02866838) before database closure [March 22, 2022] and unmasking [March 24, 2022]... The trial was prospectively registered at https://clinicaltrials.gov (August 15, 2016; NCT02866838) before enrolling the first patient.

overall_summary: This was a well-conducted, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial with centralized allocation concealment, blinding of participants and outcome assessors, almost complete follow-up, and analyses conducted according to a prespecified statistical analysis plan. All RoB 2 domains were assessed as low risk of bias.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated (1:1) to tranexamic acid or matching placebo using a computer-generated random sequence with permuted blocks.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation sequence was computer-generated, centrally allocated, and concealed using externally indistinguishable kits with baseline characteristics well balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients were randomly assigned to receive either placebo (0.9% NaCl) or tranexamic acid (1:1) using a computergenerated procedure with randomly permuted blocks of varying size. The treatment number was allocated using a centralised treatment allocation system at the baseline visit. The investigational product was distributed to the participating centres in externally indistinguishable sealed treatment kits containing either tranexamic acid or placebo contained in the identical standard off-theshelf ampoules.

domain_judgments.rationale: Double-blind administration was maintained with placebo control, no unblinding occurred, and analysis adhered to the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Treatment allocation was concealed from all patients and investigators involved in the trial... All 171 patients received the allocated treatment and were included in the intention-to-treat analysis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data for the primary endpoint were available for 98.9% of participants (only 2 missing in total), making bias from missing data negligible.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Of these, 169 (98.9%) patients had 24 hours follow-up CT scans; 89 patients were assigned to the tranexamic acid group; 82 assigned to the placebo group. 2 patients assigned tranexamic acid had missing 24 hours data... Missing outcome values were imputed assuming the worst possible primary outcome (haematoma growth).

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome was assessed using standard neuroimaging volumetric methods by central independent assessors blinded to treatment allocation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Both baseline and 24hours ICH volumes were obtained using the ABC/2 method by central independent assessors, who were masked to treatment assignment.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was registered prospectively and results were analyzed and reported in line with a prespecified published protocol and statistical analysis plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The protocol and statistical plan of TRAIGE trial has been published earlier.16... The primary analysis was based on the intention-to-treat principle and was conducted according to a prespecified statistical analysis plan... The trial is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02625948)

overall_summary: The trial was a well-conducted, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial with robust allocation concealment, blinded central outcome adjudication, virtually complete follow-up, and prespecified analyses, yielding a low risk of bias across all domains.
